lines: Every class now has a group ride starting every fifteen minutes, and the app shows you the next one.
Sessions start on the quarter hours with ten seats each, and the app asks for the next two every thirty seconds.
Class Start offers the next session: when it starts, how many have joined, and who is riding.
When it is full, Join offers the one fifteen minutes later. In its last minute, Join now says it is starting.
In the library, each open class shows its next group, counting down.
The plan and the riders stay together on every screen, from a phone to a desktop.
What the tests prove: the schedule, the countdown, a full session and the chips, read again every thirty seconds.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
